definitions.explanation: Anime productions released directly to home video (DVD/Blu-ray) rather than being broadcast on TV or shown in theaters.

examples.japanese: OVAが{発売|はつばい}された。
TV{版|ばん}より{先|さき}にOVAが{出|で}た。
examples.english: The OVA came out before the TV version.

examples.japanese: このシリーズはOVAで{完結|かんけつ}する。
examples.english: This series will conclude with an OVA.

notes:
Abbreviation of 'Original Video Animation.' Also sometimes called OAV (Original Animation Video), though OVA is more common in Japan.

CHARACTERISTICS:
OVAs are anime released directly to home video (DVD/Blu-ray) rather than broadcast on TV or shown in theaters. They often feature:
- Higher production quality than TV anime
- More mature or niche content
- Side stories or sequels to popular series
- Stories too short for a full TV season

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- OVA{化|か}: OVA adaptation
- OVA{版|ばん}: OVA version
- OVA{作品|さくひん}: OVA title/work

ETYMOLOGY:
The format became popular in the 1980s-90s when home video allowed creators more freedom. While less dominant today due to streaming, OVAs are still produced, often bundled with manga volumes as limited editions.
